Initialize_Flow_ID_variable.description: Creates Flow ID Variable used to track Flow Status

Initialize_Flow_Display_Name_variable.description: Creates Flow Display Name Variable used to track Flow Status

Initialize_Flow_URL_variable.description: Creates Flow URL variable used to Track Flow Status

Initialize_Run_ID_variable.description: Creates flow Run ID variable used to track Run ID

Create_new_Flow_Activity_Status_Morning.description: Creates new record in Flow Activity Statuses entity to track flow runs.

parameters.fetchXml:
<fetch version="1.0" output-format="xml-platform" mapping="logical" distinct="true">
  <entity name="email">
    <attribute name="subject" />
    <attribute name="regardingobjectid" />
    <attribute name="from" />
    <attribute name="to" />
    <attribute name="torecipients" />
    <attribute name="prioritycode" />
    <attribute name="statuscode" />
    <attribute name="modifiedon" />
    <attribute name="activityid" />
    <attribute name="description" />
    <order attribute="subject" descending="false" />
    <filter type="and">
      <condition attribute="category" operator="ne" value="Processed" />
      <condition attribute="category" operator="ne" value="In Progress" />
      <condition attribute="createdon" operator="last-x-days" value="1" />
    </filter>
    <link-entity name="activityparty" from="activityid" to="activityid" link-type="inner" alias="au">
      <filter type="and">
        <condition attribute="participationtypemask" operator="in">
          <value>2</value>
          <value>3</value>
        </condition>
      </filter>
      <link-entity name="queue" from="queueid" to="partyid" link-type="inner" alias="av">
        <filter type="and">
          <condition attribute="mcs_incomingteam" operator="eq" value="1" />
        </filter>
      </link-entity>
    </link-entity>
  </entity>
</fetch>

Update_with_Success_Status.description: Update the corresponding Flow Activity Status record depending on if Scope step completed successfully.  Update the End Date Time with current time, Flow Run Status to Success..

Filter_Error_Array.description: Filter workflow object based on Failed Status to retrieve Error Message.

Flow_Error_Message.description: Obtain Error Message from workflow object

Update_a_row_with_Failed_Status.description: Update the corresponding Flow Activity Status record due to one or more steps failing in the Scope above.   Update the Start Date field to Current time, Flow Run Status to Error and the Error Message field with the error retrieved from previous step.
